StaffSecurity.title: Security
StaffSecurity.ledeStaff: You have staff access. It only unlocks after a second factor — a password isn't enough.
StaffSecurity.withheldEnrolled: Confirm sign-in with a code from the app — the sections will reopen in this same session.
StaffSecurity.withheldNotEnrolled: Until a second factor is set up, staff sections are unavailable. Your regular account — trips, listings, messages — works as usual.
StaffSecurity.qrAlt: QR code for an authenticator app
StaffSecurity.enabledBody: You'll enter a code from an authenticator app when signing in.
StaffSecurity.codesWarning: We show these codes once. We only store their fingerprints and can't show them again. Each code works once — keep them wherever you keep your passwords.
StaffSecurity.confirmSavedLabel: I've saved the codes somewhere safe
StaffSecurity.scanBody: Open an authenticator app — the one you already use for work email, for instance — and scan the image. Then enter the six-digit code it shows.
StaffSecurity.enableBodyRequired: Staff access needs a second factor: a password alone isn't enough to open cases, documents, or financial data. Until it's set up, staff sections are unavailable — your regular account works as before.
StaffSecurity.enableBodyOptional: Extra account protection: signing in will need a code from an app.
StaffSecurity.passwordHint: The password is needed so no one but you can link their authenticator to your account.
StaffSecurity.challengeBody: Enter the code from your authenticator app. If your phone isn't handy — enter one of the recovery codes instead.
